title: Shrunk-frame birth and terminal composition: conditional kappa = 1.12802185097556e-4
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

This separate candidate composes shrunk frames, dead-slot birth reuse and terminal elimination. Under the inherited OpenAI #109 all-size, analytic and fixed-tape interfaces, it certifies

`T(n) = O(n (log n)^(1-kappa))`, with **`kappa = 112802185097556/10^18 = 0.000112802185097556`** and conservative dyadic corollary **`kappa = 2^-14`**.

The selected word retains 2,108 birth reuses and removes 381 distinct-target terminal roles, leaving 26,216 physical auxiliary roles. Complete reconstruction gives width 114,315,520, rank 65,843,877,440, largest child 574 and conservative scalar charge 3,116,113,870,848. Exact rational replay checks all 2,024 source and all 26,216 dirty columns in both orientations. The joint choice is checked against the actual complete paid histogram, including source and target fronts, auxiliary exteriors, copied-center losses and final endpoint correction.

The saving is approximately 193.32105577297% above PR36's `384569/10^10` and 113.68252252328% above our PR91's `52789616935221/10^18`. The comparison with the pinned #126 value `111192082577/10^15` is approximately +1.44803702138%. The final fully paginated refresh found newer, larger reported exponents: #138 at head `877da1c6e000cfaa72d8163a88acda31ed8057d6` states the exact body fraction `206798323483/500000000000000 = 0.000413596646966`, while its title displays the different value `0.000413596659368`; the exact body fraction is used here. #139 at head `52ca13342bd40027029feefe23e67dcd53ba01f6` reports `0.00045019844704` as a finite arithmetic candidate and explicitly leaves its combined physical execution theorem unproved. Those are recorded as reported working inputs with their stated scopes. This PR is a separate verified finite composition checkpoint and makes no current-frontier or global-best claim.

The final Gaussian/layer margin controls the next `10^-18` grid point in this fixed-profile balanced family. Two rational log/exp enclosure methods, three simultaneous row stocks and the completed-child bridge support all 47 strict inequalities and seven assembly margins. The 240-theorem Lean companion proves scoped rational/count statements. The inherited all-size realization, semantic/common-grid, analytic precision/recovery and fixed-tape obligations remain explicit in [PROOF.md](https://github.com/chafreaky/integer-mult-bounds/blob/3ddc4dcf7312ec5ab3bff843fd3e8c10cce041dc/research/shrunk-birth-terminal/PROOF.md); this is neither a global-optimality nor a practical-speed claim.

The portable package is under `research/shrunk-birth-terminal/`. It includes the selected word, compressed original inputs with stored/decoded hashes, complete source closure, proof, terminal packet argument, transfer certificate, reconstruction commands, independent-audit evidence and the unchanged generated Lean module. Sources reconstruct the selected witness from the pinned graph and recorded moves. The descriptive scalar-count correction is documented separately and changes no word, histogram, scalar charge, numerical bound or Lean theorem.

Chafik Boukhalfa (@chafreaky), with OpenAI Codex assistance, prepared this composition and its verification. Retained contributions are credited to:

- @jacklightChen (Zhihao Chen), controlled-basis and semantic interfaces: #23 and #29.
- @hipotures and the RaD project, paid positional, routing and semantic machinery: #41 and retained sources.

Original authorship, licenses, notices and Anthropic Claude/other assistance disclosures remain intact. `references/CONTRIBUTOR-PINS.json` records the verified GitHub attribution metadata. These credits identify dependencies and do not imply review or endorsement of the new composition.

## Validation

- One successful complete `make -j1 verify` run passed on clean construction `7b3b6f2113c0d7e61836cab409b6228e4c9b3a4d` in **1377.869 seconds** in a fresh source-only checkout: all 12 groups, **525 tests in 79 isolated modules**, and 20 patch-application checks. The first attempt stopped at the hash gate after 1193.323 seconds because the inherited producer restored numeric histogram-key ordering; parsed values were unchanged, and the repair retained those stable bytes. A second attempt stopped after 939.309 seconds on leftover ignored scratch required to be absent by an inherited producer. The fresh clone kept the exact commit, tree and 281 source/input pins while removing that runtime-state dependency. Both failed attempts are retained in the evidence. The final commit updates only the derived repository-validation receipt.
- `make verify-shrunk-terminal` passed in 62.215 seconds. It reconstructs the geometry and complete word, compares every paid bin and scalar bill, runs 18 adverse arithmetic controls and audits the Lean linkage. Nine focused repository controls also pass.
- Independent package and final source/cache audits passed. An independent Lean-to-word audit recalculated 233,458 frame transitions, 71,928 Gram matrices and all 34 paid-width bins. Fresh integrated Lean compilation and axiom checks are included in the formal CI jobs.
- All **39 published-head checks pass** at `3ddc4dcf7312ec5ab3bff843fd3e8c10cce041dc`: 12 verification groups on Python 3.11, 3.13 and 3.14, plus the historical, Gaussian and matrix formal jobs.

The local compiler environment, commands and exact log hashes are recorded in `certificates/shrunk-birth-terminal-repository-validation.json`; [REPRODUCE.md](https://github.com/chafreaky/integer-mult-bounds/blob/3ddc4dcf7312ec5ab3bff843fd3e8c10cce041dc/research/shrunk-birth-terminal/REPRODUCE.md) gives portable commands and separates arithmetic checks from fresh formal compilation. Foreign producers were accepted as reported working inputs and were not replayed solely as an admission gate. The final frontier refresh read every page of open PRs and retained exact heads and reported certificate comparisons.
